text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, fosaprepitant dimeglumine injection is in short supply. Corvale East holds 94 units (11.3 days at 8.3 units/day). Corvale General holds 166.5 units (18.7 days at 8.9 units/day). Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is discontinuing manufacture.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC discontinuing manufacture of fosaprepitant dimeglumine injection with an initial posting date of 2026-04-08. The NorthStar Rx LLC product (NDC 16714024801) lists Aspiro Pharma Limited in India as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1215606 of Aspiro Pharma Limited ended 2023-08-11 and was classified VAI, with classification known to FDA on 2023-11-17.

Our position: Current inventory covers 11 to 19 days. No other manufacturer is listed on FDA's shortage list today. Five potential suppliers have available product but their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify. Clinical alternatives are a committee decision.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to request plant information and current allocation limits from AVYXA Pharma, LLC, Actavis Pharma, Inc., Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Avenacy, LLC, and BE Pharmaceuticals Inc.; P&T Committee to approve any new vendor agreement.
2. Buyer to place initial orders with approved vendors to bridge supply; P&T Committee to approve formulary addition if required.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; P&T Committee to review at next scheduled meeting.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative antiemetic regimens without P&T Committee review and clinical guidance.
